title: Kabanchyk
description: This project adds the Boar Grove Biome, boars, and boar meat.
body:
# Kabanchik

Add a new wild animal to your Minecraft world!

Kabanchik introduces wild boars that roam forests and taigas, bringing more life and danger to the wilderness. These creatures are most active at night, making every journey through the dark forest more exciting.

## Features

* New mob: Kabanchik (Wild Boar)
* Naturally spawns in boar forest
* Active during the night
* Unique AI and behavior 
* Drops boar meat
* Vanilla-friendly gameplay
* Perfect for survival worlds

## Why should you download Kabanchik?

Minecraft's forests can sometimes feel empty. Kabanchik changes that by adding wild boars that make the world feel more alive and immersive. Whether you're exploring, hunting, or simply looking for new creatures, Kabanchik adds a fresh survival experience without changing the vanilla style of Minecraft.

Watch your step at night — the Kabanchik is out there.

### Supported Version

Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge
